note: Declared receiver DAG: receiver path -> shared stage -> implementing symbols -> protecting suites.
A static call graph cannot recover these conceptual stages, so this file is the
authoritative mapping. tools/explorer/explorer_contract.py verifies every symbol
against the analyzer's symbol table and every suite key against suites.json
(exported from test/runtests.jl), so a renamed function or a dropped suite fails
loudly instead of leaving the chain page stale.
kind: shared = infrastructure both baselines also use; initial = runs once to produce
the initial candidate; iterative = inside a receiver refinement loop;
deployment = frame-stateful wrapping of a receiver.
evidence: direct = at least one declared suite textually names a stage symbol
(contract-enforced against the coverage scan); behavioral = the declared suites
exercise the stage through the public API without naming internals - rendered
as declared-only on the coverage page, never as a direct reference.

edges.condition: valid initial candidate: return without refinement
improved invalid candidate and iterations remain

stages.title: Packet acquisition
stages.detail: LFM synchronization, guard handling, and partial-FFT branches.

stages.title: One-tap pilot-interpolated equalization + FEC
stages.detail: Pilot-interpolated one-tap equalization produces the Standard baseline candidate and FEC result, with no partial-FFT combining or refinement.

stages.title: Partial-FFT/FEC initial-candidate path
stages.detail: Pilot-trained per-band combining (with the standard one-tap path as fallback comparator) equalizes and BP-decodes the initial candidate. Lite starts where Partial-FFT+FEC ends; a valid initial candidate returns immediately.

stages.title: Posterior means and confidences
stages.detail: BP posterior log-metrics become symbol decisions and per-tone confidences.

stages.title: Anchor selection
stages.detail: Pilots always anchor; confident data decisions join up to the anchor cap. The :frozen/:genie/:graded arms swap decision anchors for nothing or for (corrupted) truth without changing the code path.

stages.title: Combiner refit
stages.detail: Ridge refit of the partial-FFT combiner W toward the anchors. Data-anchor confidence values weight the refit. Lite refits W only; the physical response C is never formed.

stages.title: Re-decode
stages.detail: The refit combiner re-equalizes the partial-FFT observations and BP re-decodes into a fresh candidate; payload extraction credits correct bits.

stages.title: Candidate selection
stages.detail: Keep the best candidate by validity then syndrome; stop on success, non-improvement, or the iteration limit.

stages.title: Frame-wide FEC receiver
stages.detail: One LDPC/BP graph spans the requested frame. The selected frame receiver processes all block observations before payload metrics are returned.

stages.title: Profiled C,z
stages.detail: The frame receiver solves C conditional on z and derives W from C. BP checks candidates before frame payload metrics are returned.

stages.title: Conditioned joint C,W,z
stages.detail: The conditioned branch makes guarded simultaneous C,W,z proposals inside the Profiled C,z frame receiver.
